}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "S SiPEED", "LM3A" and "SiPEED Lichee Module 3A" are silkscreened on SoM module top. :""SiPEED" is silkscreened on Carrier Board top. :"S", "SiPEED" and "52801" are silkscreened on Carrier Board bottom.
{{See also|SiPEED Lichee Module 3A|SiPEED|List of SBCs}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[SpacemiT]] ''Key Stone'' K1 (X60) @1.6GHz :SoC: Octa-Core RISC-V (RV64GC) 64-bit :NPU: 2.0 TOPS (AI from RlSC-V Core) *GPU: ''Imagination'' BXE-2-32 @819MHz :32KB SLC (OpenGL ES3.2) :VPU: H.264/H.265 decoder up to 4Kp60, :H.265 encoder up to 4Kp30 *Storage: 32GB (eMMC 5.1) Flash, :TF card (max.1TB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 8GB (LPDDR4X) SDRAM (''[[Biwin]]'') *Wi-Fi: [[Realtek]] RTL8723DS, SDIO 2.0 (module) :802.11bgn 1T1R (2.4GHz), BT 4.2 BLE *USB: 4x USB 3.0, 1x USB 2.0 (Device) ports *Network: 2x GbE ports *PCIe: 2x M.2 M-Key (PCIe 2.0 x2) *GPIO: 1x 20-pin headers *Power: 12V/2A via barrel or optional 802.3at PoE
